standard_prerequisites.name: Two-out-of-three for perfect objects: in a distinguished triangle, if two terms are perfect then so is the third
standard_prerequisites.use: Closes the induction step by passing from the truncated complex and the perfect module to the full complex.

core_obligations: Induct on the length of the bounded complex K (proof lines 18982-18983). The stupid truncation puts K into a distinguished triangle whose other two terms are a shorter bounded complex of perfect modules (perfect by induction) and a perfect module in a single degree (proof lines 18982-18984). By the two-out-of-three lemma for perfect objects, K itself is a perfect complex (proof lines 18982-18984).
proof_roadmap: Set up the induction on the length of the finite complex (proof lines 18982-18983).
Cut with a stupid truncation triangle and apply the two-out-of-three lemma (proof lines 18982-18984).
